vulnerability.explanation: The loop condition uses while (map[i].abfd == current_bfd) without checking i < orl_count. When i is incremented to orl_count, the next condition evaluation reads map[orl_count], an out-of-bounds access. This can occur when processing the final group of entries for a member.
